lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pm2Mg22Ti2 (PmMg11Ti) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 26 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all centers: Mg and Pm each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Ti shows 12 Mg neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component spanning all 26 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates that 12-vertex Mg polyhedra exhibit corner, edge, and face sharing, and Mg–Mg polyhedra also show corner and face sharing.
